reason: The Core container has no authenticated, least-privilege host apply and rollback channel. Compose, TLS, monitoring, and host service changes cannot be proven effective by writing Core configuration.

groups.boundary: Pin, verify, deploy, observe, and restore an image digest through the host release process. A selector is not evidence of the running image.
A typed limit change requires Compose validation, service recreation, cgroup readback, and a bounded rollback.
Changing a published port requires listener and proxy coordination, loopback-binding verification, and rollback reachability.
A one-time bootstrap proof must not become a reusable browser setting or be returned by an API.
The directory names bind-mounted certificates and private keys; changing it requires staged file and trust-chain verification.
Ingress changes require exact-origin validation, service restart, and authenticated reachability checks.
The timer is read from the environment at MCP startup; a Core write cannot reload or prove its active value.
Certificate staging requires validity, SAN, chain, and client-trust checks before coordinated service activation.
Keys stay outside Core and the browser. A future plane may accept sealed writes but must never offer key readback.

Config changes need typed validation, Prometheus config check, atomic write, authenticated reload, observed active-config readback, and rollback. The current service has no enabled lifecycle endpoint.
Routing changes need typed validation, destination allowlisting, config check, authenticated reload, delivery probe, and rollback.
These command-line retention limits require service recreation and storage-capacity verification.
Critical expressions, duration, and severity remain code-reviewed immutable detection policy; no operator mutation command.
Even noncritical rule edits require syntax validation, reload proof, alert behavior checks, and rollback.
Path and proxy changes need confinement, ownership and reachability checks; a Core-only write cannot establish host effect.
A future write must be sealed, audited by fingerprint only, and never return secret bytes.
Historical backup decryptability makes ordinary rotation unsafe; no replace or readback UI.

deploymentGaps.boundary: Build-time route base; requires a separately built frontend and proxy-route rollback.
Build-time analytics identifier; current UI intentionally exposes presence only.
Aggregate of five published ports, not proof of effective host listener bindings.
Aggregate of container CPU limits, requiring cgroup readback after service recreation.
Aggregate of container memory limits, requiring cgroup readback after service recreation.
Running digest must be observed after a pinned release; Compose image selector alone is insufficient.
